ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus) DLL side-loading via abused signed vendor binaries from user-writable paths
ucs.description: OceanLotus/Canvas Cyclone has consistently abused legitimately signed binaries from Symantec, McAfee, Adobe, and Google (AcroTranscoder.exe, RasTlsc.exe, mcoemcpy.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe) to side-load malicious DLLs (rastls.dll, wsc.dll, goopdate.dll, mcutil.dll, msvcr100.dll) carrying KerrDown, Denis, and Cobalt Strike beacons. This UC alerts when the bundle is executed from a non-standard, user-writable directory — the chained-drop signature of this group's loader.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AcroTranscoder.exe","RasTlsc.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","SymantecRMSClient.exe","McUtil.exe","VsTskMgr.exe") AND (Processes.process_path LIKE "%\\Users\\%" OR Processes.process_path LIKE "%\\ProgramData\\%" OR Processes.process_path LIKE "%\\AppData\\%" OR Processes.process_path LIKE "%\\Temp\\%" OR Processes.process_path LIKE "%\\PerfLogs\\%") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename firstTime as first_seen lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
ucs.kql:
// APT32 / OceanLotus — signed-vendor binary executed from user-writable path (side-load primer)
let SideLoadLures = dynamic(["acrotranscoder.exe","rastlsc.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","googleupdate.exe","symantecrmsclient.exe","mcutil.exe","vstskmgr.exe"]);
let SideLoadDlls = dynamic(["rastls.dll","wsc.dll","goopdate.dll","mcutil.dll","msvcr100.dll","libcef.dll","sqlite3.dll"]);
let AnomalousProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName in~ (SideLoadLures)
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
              ProcessId, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let SuspiciousLoad = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName in~ (SideLoadDlls)
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
    | project LoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, LoaderName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, LoaderPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              DllName = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath, DllSha256 = SHA256;
AnomalousProc
| join kind=leftouter SuspiciousLoad on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.LoaderPid
| extend SideLoadConfirmed = isnotempty(DllName)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
          ParentName, ParentPath, DllName, DllPath, DllSha256, SideLoadConfirmed
| order by SideLoadConfirmed desc, Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT32 / OceanLotus — signed-vendor binary executed from user-writable path (4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(AcroTranscoder|RasTlsc|mcoemcpy|wsc_proxy|GoogleUpdate|SymantecRMSClient|McUtil|VsTskMgr)\.exe$"
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Users|ProgramData|AppData|Temp|PerfLogs)\\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty) Office macro → mshta/rundll32/wscript proxy execution with C2 beacon
ucs.description: OceanLotus phishes Vietnamese government, journalist, dissident, and ASEAN-region victims with macro-laced .doc/.xls lures that spawn mshta.exe, rundll32.exe (executing comment-method JS in HTA-style payloads), or wscript.exe to fetch the KerrDown/CocoonLoader stage from Google Drive, Dropbox, or attacker infrastructure. This UC fires on the parent-child chain plus the script/HTTP indicator, then network-pivots to the staging beacon.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("WINWORD.EXE","EXCEL.EXE","POWERPNT.EXE","OUTLOOK.EXE") AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process LIKE "%.hta%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%javascript:%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%http%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%DownloadString%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%IEX%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%-EncodedCommand%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%-enc %" OR Processes.process LIKE "%scrobj.dll%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%RunHTMLApplication%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%mshtml%") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_id as child_pid host as src | join type=inner src [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app IN ("mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe") AND All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,443,8080,8443) AND NOT (All_Traffic.dest_category="internal") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as src dest as c2_dest dest_port as c2_port app as egress_proc] | rename firstTime as first_seen lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
ucs.kql:
// APT32 / OceanLotus — Office macro spawns LOLBin proxy + same-process egress
let Lookback = 7d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let OceanLotusKids = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".hta","javascript:","vbscript:","http://","https://","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","scrobj.dll","RunHTMLApplication","mshtml,RunHTMLApplication")
        or (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)rundll32\.exe\s+[\"']?[A-Za-z]:\\(?:Users|ProgramData|AppData|Temp)\\[^\s,\"']+\.(?:dll|ocx|cpl|tmp|dat|bin)[\"']?\s*,")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildName = FileName, ChildPid = ProcessId,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let Beacons = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | project BeaconTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, BeaconPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              BeaconProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
OceanLotusKids
| join kind=leftouter Beacons on DeviceId, $left.ChildPid == $right.BeaconPid
| extend DelaySec = iff(isnotempty(BeaconTime), datetime_diff('second', BeaconTime, Timestamp), int(null))
| where isnull(DelaySec) or DelaySec between (0 .. 600)
| project Timestamp, BeaconTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentName, ParentCmd, ChildName, ChildCmd, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT32 / OceanLotus — Office macro → LOLBin proxy execution (4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(WINWORD|EXCEL|POWERPNT|OUTLOOK)\.EXE$"
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$"
| where CommandLine has_any (".hta","javascript:","vbscript:","http://","https://","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","scrobj.dll","RunHTMLApplication","mshtml")
    or (NewProcessName endswith "rundll32.exe" and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)rundll32\.exe\s+[\"']?[A-Za-z]:\\(Users|ProgramData|AppData|Temp)\\[^\s,\"']+\.(dll|ocx|cpl|tmp|dat|bin)[\"']?\s*,")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, NewProcessId, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
